## Domain Migration & Canonical Authority

The personal entity remains separate from the Seven Eighty Three foundry and its ventures. These are first-party identity records, not independent corroboration.

- Seven Eighty Three (Lab 783): https://seveneightythree.com/ . Systems laboratory and venture foundry; an operating lab of Angel.

- Pogo: https://pogo.vet/ . Venture via Seven Eighty Three.
- BASALT: https://basalt.fm/ . Deterministic 7.83 Hz acoustic calibration, lossless mastering, and live radio. Specification: https://basalt.fm/spec . Canonical engine: https://basalt.fm/#engine.
- Bullpen: https://bullpen.vip/ . Baseball coaching and swing lab cofounded with player-coach Jordy Oriach.
- Apsis: https://apsis.club/ . Zero-commission publishing with Apogee and Perigee patronage tiers.
- Communal Foundation: https://communalfoundation.org/ . Food API specification, available for acquisition, not deployed.
- Retention Rail: https://retentionrail.io/ . Foundry venture.
- Casa Josefin: https://casajosefin.com/ . Culinary publishing house and domestic archive led by Josefin Oriach.

## The Angel / Angel Capital

Gotham Gay is the personal index of Argelys Samuel Oriach and home of Angel, his independent angel investment firm. Gotham Gay and The Gotham Gay are alternate firm names. The entities share a website but remain distinct: Person https://theangel.biz/#person and Organization https://angelventures.biz/#organization. Argelys Samuel Oriach is its founder and managing principal. The Angel is the top-level capital umbrella. Seven Eighty Three and Wild Lake Studio are its two operating labs.

Mandate: pre-seed and seed capital for zero-dependency systems, brutalist infrastructure, and founder-led companies. Check size: $25K to $250K. Governance: zero board seats. Capital mandate and allocation matrix: https://angelventures.biz/#capital . Gated vehicle: https://angelventures.biz/ . The active ledger lists ventures and creative works; inclusion alone does not assert a completed equity investment.

The optional stereo reference generates 136.10 Hz on the left and 143.93 Hz on the right, a 7.83 Hz frequency difference. It starts only by user action and makes no medical claims.

## Current two-tier capital hierarchy

Gotham Gay (https://angelventures.biz/#organization) is the root capital organization. Argelys Samuel Oriach (https://theangel.biz/#person) is its managing principal.

### Tier I / Operating Labs (2)

- Seven Eighty Three (https://seveneightythree.com/): Systems laboratory and venture foundry building zero-dependency digital infrastructure and the Universe API.
- Wild Lake Studio (https://wildlakestudio.com/): Talent architecture and sovereign A&R lab building operational, somatic, and digital infrastructure for independent artists.

### Tier II / Internal Portfolio (8)

- BASALT (https://basalt.fm/): Deterministic 7.83 Hz acoustic calibration engine, radio tuner, and PCM WAV mastering API.
- Apsis (https://apsis.club/): Zero-commission direct-to-fan publishing and live broadcast engine with Apogee and Perigee brackets.
- Bullpen (https://bullpen.vip/): Zero-commission kinematic swing telemetry and private video coaching lab for baseball players.
- Communal Foundation (https://communalfoundation.org/): Closed-loop food-systems architecture routing chef networks, demand, and delivery on the Food API specification. Documented and available for acquisition.
- Retention Rail (https://retentionrail.io/): Post-sale net dollar retention and recurring revenue infrastructure. 50% equity position.
- Casa Josefin (https://casajosefin.com/): Culinary publishing venture and domestic archive: The Table, The Page, The House.
- Pogo (https://pogo.vet/): Canine lineage verification ledger and 7.83 Hz calming audio protocol.
- Literary & Dramatic IP (https://thisisnotalovestory.net/): This Is Not a Love Story (Yankees), a digital short written as a screenplay in prose form; the forthcoming hybrid collection Graduation; a one-act play; and a pilot.

The Angel: https://angelventures.biz/ . Canonical organization: https://angelventures.biz/#organization. The personal site remains https://angelventures.biz/ .

## Definitive firm name

Angel Ventures is the full firm name; Angel is its public short name. Canonical firm: https://angelventures.biz/#organization at https://angelventures.biz/ . The Angel is a historical alternate name.

## Personal doorway / Firm boundary

The Angel is Argelys Samuel Oriach. His personal index at https://angelventures.biz/ connects to the separate firm Angel Ventures at https://angelventures.biz/ . He reviews ventures for alignment with the firm’s values before they enter consideration. The Person ID remains https://theangel.biz/#person; the firm ID is https://angelventures.biz/#organization.

## Site separation

Angel Ventures is hosted at https://angelventures.biz/ . Argelys Samuel Oriach’s personal index and biography are hosted at https://theangel.biz/ . Legacy argelysoriach.com and gothamgay.com requests route to the firm, except biography requests which route to The Angel.
